svg.title: R-life-P - Life Support - plan
svg.text: Life Support keeps the ship breathable: it strips CO2 and trace contaminants from the cabin air, re-balances
oxygen, and reclaims and polishes every litre of waste and condensate water.
CO2 scrubbers (east wall, north of the door)
Filter bank (east wall, south of the door)
Potable storage and air processing (west facets)
Oxygen and cryogenic gas store (north facets)
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
DECK 3 - ENGINEERING DECK - FLOOR PLAN AT FFL +0.000
